title: SARS-CoV-2 Sequencing on Illumina MiSeq Using ARTIC Protocol: Part 2
author: Joel Sevinsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bffyjjpw
materials: [ ] Vortex and quick spin master mix.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Dilution Plate
steps.instruction: Dilute samples into a 96-well plate so that the final volume contains 100 ng to 500 ng of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Label a 96-well dilution plate with the required number of columns.
Add enough DNA to reach at least 100 ng (preferred range: 100 ng to 500 ng).
Add molecular grade water (CED) to bring the total volume to 30 µL.

steps.title: Tagment DNA
steps.instruction: Use Bead-Linked Transposomes (BLT) to fragment and tag the DNA with adapter sequences.

substeps.instruction: Vortex BLT and ensure both reagents are at room temperature.
Prepare tagmentation Master Mix using Calculation 1.
Vortex master mix and add 20 µL to each sample well; pipette 10 times to mix.
Place the plate in the thermal cycler and run the TAG Program at 55°C.

steps.title: Post-Tagmentation Clean-up
steps.instruction: Stop tagmentation and wash the adapter-tagged DNA on the BLT. Ensure all reagents are at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Check TSB for precipitates, then add 10 µL to each sample well and slowly pipette 10 times to resuspend beads.
Seal the plate with Microseal 'B' (CED) and run the PTC Program on the thermal cycler.
Place plate on magnet for 00:03:00 or until clear.
Remove from magnet, add 100 µL TWB, and pipette slowly to mix (avoid foaming).
Place back on magnet for 00:03:00 or until clear, then remove and discard supernatant.
Repeat the TWB wash two more times. After the second wash, leave the plate in the magnet and wait to discard supernatant.

steps.title: Amplify Tagmented DNA
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA using a limited-cycle PCR program to add Index 1 (i7) and Index 2 (i5) adapters.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix using Calculation 2.
Remove and discard TWB from samples, remove from magnet, and immediately add 40 µL PCR master mix; pipette to mix.
Add 10 µL indices and pipette to mix.
Seal the plate with Microseal 'B' (CED) and run the BLT PCR Program (5 cycle PCR) on the thermal cycler.

steps.title: Clean-up Libraries
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified libraries using a double-sided bead purification procedure.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate at 280 x g (Room temperature) for 1 minute, then place on magnet for 00:05:00 or until clear.
Transfer 45 µL of supernatant to clean wells of a new midi plate (CED) and remove from magnet.
Prepare fresh 80% volume EtOH: Mix 0.4 mL * (#samples+1) EtOH and 0.1 mL * (#samples+1) molecular grade water.
Seal (CED) plate and incubate for at least 00:05:00.
Place plate on magnet for 00:02:00 and transfer 30 µL supernatant to new wells.
Vortex RSB and add 32 µL; pipette to mix and incubate at Room temperature for 00:02:00.
Air dry beads for approximately 00:05:00, then remove plate from magnet.
Perform two 00:00:30 washes with 200 µL 80% volume EtOH, discarding supernatant after each. Use a 20 µL pipette to remove residual EtOH after the second wash without disturbing beads.
Place on magnet for 00:05:00 or until clear, then remove and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify Libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified libraries using Qubit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Qubit working solution using Calculation 5 and label assay tubes.
Combine 190 µL Qubit working solution and 10 µL Qubit standard into standard tubes.
Combine 198 µL Qubit working solution and 2 µL extracted DNA into sample tubes.
Vortex all tubes for 2-3 seconds, incubate at Room temperature for minimum 00:02:00, and read within 01:00:00.

steps.title: Denature Pooled Library
steps.instruction: Generate a pooled library for V3 reagents on the MiSeq.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate at 280 x g (Room temperature) for 1 minute.
Create a 4 nanomolar (nM) pool using Calculation 6 (Molarity = (Pool conc. x 1000) / 528; Volume of pool = (4 x 50) / Molarity; Volume of RSB = 50 - Volume of pool).
Prepare 0.2 N NaOH by adding 400 µL molecular grade H2O to 100 µL 1.0 N NaOH.
Combine 5 µL 0.2 N NaOH and 5 µL pooled DNA in a 1.5 mL tube; incubate 00:05:00 at Room temperature.
Immediately add 990 µL pre-chilled HT1 and pipette to mix.

Adjust final loading concentration by mixing Denatured Pooled Library and HT1 according to the provided table (e.g., for 10pM, use 1000µl library and 0µl HT1; for 20pM, use 900µl library and 100µl HT1).

steps.title: Final Clean-up
steps.instruction: Perform final clean-up of the pooled library.

substeps.instruction: Cover and seal the plate with Microseal 'B' (CED).
Add 81 µL of SPB to samples and pipette 10 times to mix.
